Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette rust-charcoal. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
